name: Cañamares (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cañamares (a castle on white, a bend on red and hemp plants on white).
history: Municipal flag of Cañamares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cañamares arms — castle, bend and hemp plants
